description: A chief legal officer must approve the Hartwell acquisition's pre-closing HSR filing package and specify the transaction value, voting-interest description, filing fee, and supporting workpapers, with input from corporate governance and compliance counsel.

shared_context.S1: The company plans to sign the Hartwell acquisition agreement in nine business days.
shared_context.S2: Elena Morris gives final approval to the pre-closing Hart-Scott-Rodino filing package.
shared_context.S3: The current HSR size-of-transaction threshold for this transaction type is $119,500,000.
shared_context.S4: Under the applicable fee schedule, a reportable transaction valued from $100,000,000 through $200,000,000 requires a $45,000 filing fee.
shared_context.S5: The legal team routinely conducts a governance and antitrust check-in before Elena approves an HSR filing package, and each counsel reviews the relevant filing workpapers and reports any updates during that check-in.
shared_context.S6: The filing approval memorandum must identify the factual basis for each material filing entry and list the supporting workpapers included in the package.

PF1.text: Victor reviewed a capitalization amendment delivered by Hartwell's counsel yesterday and confirmed that the acquisition will give the company exactly 42% of Hartwell's voting securities; he has not circulated the revised ownership chart because the amendment arrived after the last diligence meeting.

PF2.text: Nadia reconciled the final purchase-price schedule with Finance this morning and confirmed that the HSR transaction value is exactly $121,400,000; the consolidated valuation memo is still awaiting Finance's sign-off and has not yet been added to the filing folder.

settlement_schema.instruction: Cite each formally revealed private fact in justification_fact_ids and include the same fact identifier in revealed.

acceptance_conditions: The package must approve filing an HSR notification.
The filing must state a transaction value of exactly $121,400,000.
The filing must state that the company will acquire exactly 42% of Hartwell's voting securities.
The filing fee must be set at exactly $45,000.
The package must include a current voting-ownership chart reflecting exactly 42% acquired voting securities.
The package must include a signed transaction-valuation memo reflecting exactly $121,400,000.
The approval record must cite PF1 as a formally revealed justification.
The approval record must cite PF2 as a formally revealed justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Victor Chen' and 'ownership chart' in c['detail'] and '42' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Nadia Brooks' and 'valuation memo' in c['detail'] and ('$121,400,000' in c['detail'] or '$121.4M' in c['detail'] or '121400000' in c['detail'] or '121.4 million' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The capitalization amendment changes the filing's voting-interest description to exactly 42% and changes the required ownership-chart commitment to one expressly reflecting exactly 42%.

The reconciled purchase-price schedule changes the transaction value to exactly $121,400,000, which exceeds the $119,500,000 threshold, requires filing, selects the $45,000 fee tier, and changes the valuation-memo commitment to one expressly reflecting exactly $121,400,000.
